candidate.name: exact Laguna head RMSNorm + partial RoPE + BF16 KV append
schedule: retain the existing local256 one-block-per-Q-or-K-head RMSNorm reduction, stride-128..1 shared-memory tree, F32-weight multiply, and partial/full RoPE expressions
query-head blocks remain arithmetically and structurally unchanged
each of the eight K-head blocks stores the exact F32 rotated key scratch row and converts that same register value to BF16 directly into its physical cache row
threads 0..127 of each K-head block load the matching F32 value element and store the current RNE-BF16 value cache row; threads 128..255 still participate in the unchanged RMS reduction barriers
the first K-head block thread 0 reproduces the standalone global or SWA writer metadata update for live_counts, token_positions, and evict_mask
kernel completion remains the only required cross-block synchronization before the following attention launch

traffic_effect.note: The design preserves observable F32 key scratch and all value/cache traffic; only the writer reread of the just-produced key row is removed.

candidate.unfused_fallback: registered head RMSNorm+partial RoPE followed by registered global/SWA KV writer; mandatory for rows>1, gfx1151/unmeasured backends, registry/shape miss, explicit rollback, and any unsupported capture mode

candidate_ranking.candidate: head RMSNorm + partial RoPE + BF16 KV append
candidate_ranking.reason: largest fresh block-local exact launch boundary; existing K-head blocks have the output registers and idle post-reduction lanes needed to append K/V without a global producer counter

candidate_ranking.candidate: global/SWA attention decode + per-head softplus gate
candidate_ranking.reason: also block-local and exact, but must pay softplus/BF16 post-op work inside long context-sensitive attention bodies; D10 and D13 require an independent mechanical/category decision rather than an assumed additive bundle
requires completion across 1,536 output producer workgroups per layer and a global counter; D11 showed this class can shorten a window while regressing total kernel sum

candidate_ranking.candidate: IQ3 selected down + D9 aggregate tail
candidate_ranking.reason: requires completion across 3,072 output workgroups and entangles the separately fused weighted-down and aggregate-tail boundaries

micro: 50 warmups/mode and 15 counterbalanced repetitions with at least 500 inclusive head+writer or fused launches/sample on actual global layers 0/44 and SWA layers 1/47
all four actual endpoint cases must preserve F32 query/key bits, BF16 K/V bits, and metadata and improve both HIP-event and synchronized-wall medians
cached trace must show the global/SWA fused symbols at local256, dynamic LDS1024, VGPR<=32, scratch0, 56/80 blocks, exactly 48 fused calls/token, and no standalone KV writer
model: all 48 post-layer hidden rows, full logits/argmax bits, final/post-layer hidden, complete K/V and KVLiveSpans, reset/re-prefill, and lifecycle must remain exact
clean short/512/1K/near-4K fused family, total kernel sum, dispatch span, and profiled-child throughput must each improve with 727 classified dispatches/token
only after the mechanical gate passes, the complete counterbalanced ten-prompt/four-category h16/h32 gate must preserve every ID/quality/state/lifecycle check and be non-regressive in every category
red: missing global/SWA four-axis wrappers and registry keys must fail before implementation
synthetic global partial-64 and SWA full-128 query/key F32 outputs, BF16 cache rows, and every KVLiveSpans field must equal the existing head-plus-writer chain bit-for-bit
cover positions 0/255/256/4095 globally and 0/511/512/513/1024 in SWA, permuted physical offsets, eviction/reused slots, BF16 halfway cases, signed zero, finite extremes, and non-finite classes
gfx1151, rows>1, registry/shape miss, and explicit disable must execute the existing two-kernel fallback
implementation_gate.retention: promote only after all gates; otherwise remove the fused route and retain D12 head-plus-writer fallback without default-off debt

measured_opportunity.interpretation: The short same-work launch-gap model saves 0.203 ms/token and reaches only 49.48 tok/s. The impossible zero-increment ceiling also removes the complete writer body, saves 0.369 ms/token, and reaches 49.89 tok/s. D14 is selected as an exact incremental win, not a standalone 50 tok/s claim.
